author: olpipi
title: Conformance (OP) Pack Artifacts fails - tar file changed as we read it
signature: tar file changed as we read it|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Conformance (OP)
failed_jobs.symptom: Pack Conformance Artifacts step exits with code 1 during tar file creation

key_errors: ##[error]Process completed with exit code 1. (step: Pack Conformance Artifacts)
tar -cvf - * | pigz > conformance_artifacts.tar.gz  <- step that failed
Log shows extensive tar file listing followed by exit code 1, consistent with 'tar: file changed as we read it'
root_cause: The 'Pack Conformance Artifacts' step runs `tar -cvf - * | pigz > conformance_artifacts.tar.gz` immediately after conformance test execution. The tar command exits with code 1 because conformance test processes are still writing report XML files to the same directory while tar is reading it, causing the 'tar: file changed as we read it' race condition. This is a known recurring issue with the pack step in the Conformance (OP) job.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure/CI-specific race condition between test processes and tar archiving
recommended_actions: Wait for all conformance test processes to complete before invoking tar (add explicit process synchronization)
Use a separate staging directory: first copy completed artifacts to a staging area, then pack from there
Alternatively, add `|| true` or use `tar --warning=no-file-changed` to tolerate file-changed warnings (exit code 1 = warning in GNU tar)
prevention_strategies: Add a synchronization barrier between conformance test completion and artifact packaging. Consider using `rsync` to copy artifacts first, then tar from the copied directory. Also consider `tar --ignore-failed-read` for more resilient archiving.
historical_context: This failure pattern (c0643d23262bbd29) has been seen 3 times previously: 2026-07-28, 2026-08-11, and 2026-08-19. Each time it occurred in the Conformance (OP) job's Pack Conformance Artifacts step.
